item.title: Olivia Rodrigo Jokes About Jake Paul, Performs ‘Drivers License’ Parody in ‘SNL’ Monologue: Watch
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's entertainment update. On May 2nd, Olivia Rodrigo made her mark as the host and musical guest on Saturday Night Live.
[Short music transition]
Host: During her opening monologue, the 23-year-old pop star reminisced about watching SNL as a teenager and even named her favorite current cast members. She also took the opportunity to plug her upcoming album, "You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love", which is set to release on June 12th.
[Short music transition]
Host: Rodrigo also looked back on her early acting days on the Disney Channel series Bizaardvark, where she starred alongside Jake Paul. In a humorous anecdote, she recalled their conversations about their future aspirations, with Rodrigo wanting to create music and Paul wanting to box.
[Short music transition]
Host: The singer even closed her monologue with a parody of her hit song "Drivers License", this time singing about getting her real ID. She also performed her previously released track "Drop Dead" and debuted a new song called "Begged" during the episode.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's update. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time.
